description:
What a US street address is in: its city or town, county, ZIP, congressional and state legislative districts
    and voting precinct, and optionally who represents it.

    Give one line with street, city and state: '233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL' (a ZIP helps). The address is matched
    by the free U.S. Census Geocoder (sent to census.gov, not stored here), then located exactly as locate_point does:
    the answer has `matched_address`, `lat`, `lon` and the same `results` (pass `levels` to narrow them).
    include_officials=True adds `officials`, the same list find_officials gives for that point. US addresses only:
    for Canada, or when you already have coordinates, call locate_point. PO boxes and new construction may not match;
    then fall back to the ZIP with get_geography('us:zcta:<zip>').
name: lookup_address
title: Look up a US street address
